description: This file defines a final class EnableConnectionLogsStrategy that extends AbstractEphemeralStrategy for handling EnableConnectionLogs commands in a messaging persistence context. It provides methods to generate a response and specify connection actions related to enabling connection logs.

classes.name: EnableConnectionLogsStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles EnableConnectionLogs commands by generating responses and determining connection actions. It extends AbstractEphemeralStrategy specialised for EnableConnectionLogs.

methods.name: EnableConnectionLogsStrategy
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the strategy for EnableConnectionLogs commands.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Creates and returns an EnableConnectionLogsResponse using the current connection state id and provided headers.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of connection actions to broadcast, respond, and enable logging.
